speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms: have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as diarrhea or constipation, or any blood in your stool? Also, do you have any history of gallbladder issues or recent travel?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin's lymphoma presenting with B-symptoms and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy).
